# Poseidon Network Systems

> IT services company in Sea Point, Cape Town, South Africa, since 2004. Dell Technologies Authorized Partner and authorised Switch Telecom reseller. Remote-first IT support, business VoIP and new and refurbished Dell equipment for small and medium businesses.

## Services
- [Business VoIP and hosted switchboards](https://poseidon-network.com/business-voip-cape-town.html): Switch Telecom VoIP, cloud switchboard, number porting, Microsoft Teams calling, handsets set up before delivery. Free phone bill review and free remote network readiness check.
- [Refurbished Dell laptops and desktops](https://poseidon-network.com/refurbished-dell-equipment.html): business-grade, factory reconditioned and tested, Windows 11 (Home or Pro, depending on the model), 1-year warranty. Delivered within 40km of Cape Town.
- [New Dell equipment](https://poseidon-network.com/new-dell-equipment.html): new Dell laptops, desktops and servers.
- [Remote IT support](https://poseidon-network.com/): helpdesk and troubleshooting over secure remote access, usually within one business day. Onsite only when that's the only way to solve a problem.
